# Cannot Compute: Missing Required Input

I cannot compute a definitive embedded-emissions figure. The ruleset requires the SEE to be selected jointly by **CN code and country**, and the scenario does not identify the good's CN code.

## Input Check

| Required input | Provided? | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) Good CN code in the table | ❌ No | **Missing.** "Steel goods" is not a CN code. |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | ✅ India | Listed for every CN code in the table |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | ✅ 3,000 t | Valid |

## Why "Steel goods" Is Insufficient

Several CN codes in the table could describe steel goods, and each has a different default SEE for India:

| CN code | Good | India SEE (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|---|
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, of iron and non-alloy steel | 2.64 |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel | 4.32 |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods, of iron or non-alloy steel, with indentations… | 4.27 |

(7201, pig iron and spiegeleisen, is listed too, but it is not normally classified as a steel good.)

Choosing among these would be an estimate, which the ruleset prohibits.

## What I Need to Complete the Calculation

**The specific CN code of the goods produced**, for example 7206 10 00, 7207 11 90, or 7214 20 00.

Once you confirm the CN code, I will calculate:

> Embedded emissions = India SEE for that CN code × 3,000 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.

If the 3,000 t covers more than one type of steel good, please also give the tonnage for each CN code so each line can be calculated separately.
